structure.unit: Medical Care Facilities Certificate of Public Need

law.catch_line: Enjoining project undertaken without certificate or registration
law.text: On petition of the Commissioner, the Board or the Attorney General, the circuit court of the county or city where a project is under construction or is intended to be constructed, located, or undertaken shall have jurisdiction to enjoin any project that is constructed, undertaken, or commenced without a certificate or registration required by this article or to enjoin the admission of patients to the project or to enjoin the provision of services through the project.
